evidence_scope: Primary-source reading and interpretation; no new scientific experiments

sources.title: Let CSP Be Your ANCHOR: Adaptive Crystal Search over Frozen Structure Priors
sources.read_depth: Methods, main experiments, Appendix C reward tilting, selected backbone-update results
sources.supports: Composition allocation and adaptive novelty can change discovery outcomes under the tested CSP backbones.
sources.interpretation: Use composition/conditional decomposition to study adaptation; do not generalize freezing into a universal optimum.
sources.corpus_definition: v2附录F.6：搜索保存composition和scores；27,136个训练结构由重放访问组成重新实现，未按稳定或新颖阈值筛选，不能将全体语料称为成功终点。

sources.title: PLaID++: A Preference Aligned Language Model for Targeted Inorganic Materials Design
sources.status: ICML 2026 main conference; initial submission September 2025
sources.supports: Representation and iterative sampling/learning affect stability and SUN differently.
sources.interpretation: Motivates separating physical qualification from concentration of successful outcomes.

sources.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
sources.supports: Known finite-set coverage objective and occupancy interpretation; category axes specified in advance.
sources.interpretation: The coverage identity is prior art. Crystal qualification and output classes are open and evaluated after physical processing.

sources.title: Efficient Symmetry-Aware Materials Generation via Hierarchical Generative Flow Networks
sources.status: Read November 2024 arXiv v1; publisher record is separate
sources.read_depth: Hierarchical-policy description, Section 5 mode exploration and Section 10.7 mode definition
sources.supports: Symmetry hierarchy and reward-proportional generation are established crystal techniques.
sources.interpretation: Its cited mode-count definition includes negative formation energy and distinct compositions; this is not the project's strict post-relaxation SUN definition.

sources.title: Illuminating the property space in crystal structure prediction using Quality-Diversity algorithms
sources.read_depth: Abstract, method overview and property-space/results sections available in primary HTML/search extracts
sources.supports: MAP-Elites already seeks multiple low-energy property-diverse crystals in fixed-composition systems.
sources.interpretation: A diverse archive alone is established capability; the open-set generative learning question requires additional knowledge.

sources.title: Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity for Crystal Structure Prediction
sources.supports: Multi-objective property/quality archives are prior work in crystal structure prediction.
sources.interpretation: Used as background, not as detailed evidence for optimization or generalization claims.

sources.title: Project historical evidence: JTF and F800
sources.source_type: local experiment records summarized in the repository historical-evidence document
sources.read_depth: Previously reconciled experiment summaries and their evaluation timing
sources.supports: JTF increases known stable endpoints in one matched-source comparison; F800 increases confirmed SUN with recorded N/U changes.
sources.interpretation: Historical pre-relaxation N/U and post-relaxation energy do not identify the amount of endpoint merging.
